name: SP Group (Singapore Power)

scam_info.sample: Notice that while the sender address states < ebillsummary@singaporepower.com.sg >, the actual sender is <tonylow@sanlaksa.com.sg>.
scam_info.notes: Old (2016) fake e-bill email advisory. Indicators: displayed (spoofed) sender ebillsummary@singaporepower.com.sg = genuine SP Services address being spoofed; actual sender tonylow@sanlaksa.com.sg (fake/compromised). 'The official SP Services bill summary sent by email does NOT contain any attachment.'

scam_info.sample: SP Group has been alerted to cases of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be our Human Resource officers.

scam_info.notes: Sitemap (90 URLs) lists 84 news-and-media-releases pages; the advisories above are the only scam ones found. The Nov 2024 SP Group phishing wave (fake double-charge/refund emails) appears on SPF/news/Facebook per web search - unverified (search snippet) - not as a page on spgroup.com.sg.

emails: ebillsummary@singaporepower.com.sg (genuine SP Services e-bill sender, as stated in 2016 advisory)

notes: Next.js site. official_domains: spgroup.com.sg (b: serves site + portal subdomains); spservices.sg (b: SP Utilities Portal services.spservices.sg and chat linked in header); spdigital.sg, spmobility.sg, spgroup-asia.com (b: group links); singaporepower.com.sg (a: ebillsummary@singaporepower.com.sg described as the genuine SP Services sender address, 2016). No current scam advisory list, no SMS sender ID or hotline on pages read; '/fraud-whistleblowing' is an internal-fraud whistleblowing page. SPF brand tag 'SP Group' (sample scam domain samgirasg.com in SPF data).
